Qty Add to Cart Description Mid-Fi Electronics Hieracium Pedal The Hieracium pedal is no ordinary overdrive. It reacts to your playing, shaping your tone like a dynamic, cranked-up vintage amp. Whether you dig in or ease up, it delivers a warm, responsive sound that feels alive under your fingers. Mid-Fi Electronics Hieracium Pedal Review This envelope-controlled overdrive brings the character of a small tweed amp into your rig. It responds to your picking dynamics, delivering anything from subtle grit to a full, rich overdrive. With simple gain and volume controls, dialing in the perfect tone is effortless.
